name: Activepieces
tagline: MIT-licensed open-source AI automation builder replacing Zapier and Make
real_test_summary: Deployed self-hosted Docker container on macOS M2 and ran automated webhook-to-Ollama summarization flows using ~420MB RAM.
pros: Permissive MIT license for commercial self-hosting
Clean no-code builder similar to Zapier
Built-in AI agent and MCP tool connectors
cons: Fewer niche enterprise connectors than n8n
description: No-code workflow automation tool with native AI agent steps, human-in-the-loop approvals, and local Ollama support runnable self-hosted via Docker.
